modules.name: Character textures and growth
modules.summary: Reconcile sprite-sheet changes before drawing. Register the new texture or move the sprite when all seven usable sampler slots are occupied. Native grown Mario renders with his actual sprite.

modules.name: Power-up goals and interception
modules.summary: Identify active power-up blocks, release a mushroom, intercept a moving item and abandon blocked optional detours. Persist failed block goals for the same authored level.

modules.name: Persistent motor experience
modules.summary: Score local strategies by progress, pickups, damage and failure. Retain useful strategies, explore poor contexts and save per-level experience. Original-level target prefix improves from 1117 to 839 ticks in the recorded comparison.

modules.name: Finite autonomous practice
modules.summary: Learn 5 runs restarts from the authored scene after every measured episode. The native two-run batch and takeover cancellation pass. Human Stop, Take over and Escape remain authoritative.

modules.name: Mario identity in model observations
modules.summary: Bounded scene observations identify Mario, his small, big or fire form, current sprite sheet, position, grounded state and death state from real engine components.

modules.name: Hrm sensory cortex
modules.summary: The existing neural core receives live sensory input and supports separately controlled plasticity. The measured route improvement in this edition comes from explicit goal memory and motor scores.

modules.name: Broader embodied self improvement
modules.summary: Synchronize visual-model frames, collect replayable episodes and demonstrations, train reward-linked policies, and evaluate isolated candidates on held out levels before promotion or rollback.
